en: price, landed cost, fees, packaging, picking, shipping and return allowance give the margin of every SKU on all five channels with a verdict
mt: 价格、到岸成本、费用、包装、拣货、运输和退货津贴给出了所有五个渠道上每个 SKU 的利润率

en: each price change with its date, reason and size, kept for every SKU and channel
mt: 为每个 SKU 和渠道保留每次价格变动及其日期、原因和金额

en: One row per SKU with cost, weight, the five channel prices and status; landed cost, markup and the margin on each channel fill in by themselves.
mt: 每个 SKU 一行，包含成本、重量、五个渠道的价格和状态；每个渠道的到岸成本、加成和利润自行填写。

en: One row per SKU and channel; price, landed cost, fees, packaging, picking, shipping and return allowance are taken from the other pages and give the margin, a verdict and the target and floor price.
mt: 每个 SKU 和渠道一行；价格、到岸成本、费用、包装、提货、运输和退货津贴取自其他页面，并给出保证金、判决以及目标价格和底价。

en: Price history of every SKU and channel
mt: 每个 SKU 和渠道的价格历史记录

en: One row per price check of a similar seller; our web price, the gap, how old the check is and whether it is the latest check of the SKU fill in.
mt: 类似卖家的每张价格检查一行；我们的网络价格、差距、支票多久以及是否是该SKU填写的最新支票。

en: One row per bundle with up to three SKUs and the bundle price; component cost, the saving for the customer, the margin after fees and a verdict fill in.
mt: 每捆绑一排，最多包含三个 SKU 和捆绑价格；组件成本、为客户节省的费用、扣除费用后的利润以及填写的判决。

en: One row per SKU and channel planned for a promotion with the promo price and expected units; the discount, the margin at the promo price and the margin given away fill in.
mt: 计划进行促销的每个 SKU 和渠道一行，包含促销价格和预期单位；填写折扣、促销价格的利润和赠送的利润。
